name_full: 迈赫兰内·萨利曼 Mehraneh Salimian
introduction: The Iranian filmmaker has an MFA in film from the School of the Art Institute of Chicago (SAIC). Her work, which spans documentary, fiction and video installation, explores the intersection of public and private spaces and the sensory dimensions of personal and collective memory. Her films have been screened at international festivals and exhibited in major venues including Expo Chicago, the Dittmar Memorial Gallery at Northwestern University and the SITE Gallery at SAIC.
